notes.title: Q&A
notes.content:
Hello Players! 👋

Welcome to the first devlog after the release of El Dorado: The Golden City Builder Prologue. We’re very impressed by how many of you decided to give the Prologue version a try as well as with the warm welcome we’ve received. ❤️‍ The amount of feedback you gave us and all the questions you’ve asked showing your genuine interest were very encouraging and today, instead of a normal devlog, we’d like to answer some of the most frequently asked questions about the game.

1. In which historical period does the El Dorado: The Golden City Builder take place? 📅
The gameplay in our game takes place at the brink of the classical period- over 600 years before conquistadors discovered these lands. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39052778/1fc705e798756e8c375aea95071b32e28a5c053a.png
2. Why is there no money as an in-game resource? 💰
Ancient Mayan did not have any need for money. Most commonly, the goods were being exchanged in a barter trade. The best example of something that replaced money for them were cacao seeds or valuable ores. There was no universal currency that would be honored in all the Mayan cities. This is the reason why in the game, the city does not get richer in money but in people. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39052778/2925475c20b3966cf2f0c1ee7abb21bce0ff1c0e.png
3. Why are the slaves painted in blue? 🔵
Slaves in the game are more than often used as sacrifices. According to texts dating back to the XVI century, blue was a color reserved for sacrifices for gods. To stress that the slaves are property of gods they were painted blue. If you’d like to read more about the meaning of blue dye in the Ancient Mayan culture we’re giving you a link to a fascinating article covering this topic! 🤩
https://www.eurekalert.org/news-releases/813702

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39052778/bce13156178179ad76850918beea824471c09266.png
4. What are the cenotes? 💦
Cenotes are natural karst wells filled with drinking water. Mayan people paid special attention to those natural formations not just because of the drinking water. They believed, those are the gates to the realm of gods. That’s why many settlements were placed nearby them.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39052778/9c6c6118be5b8329110083bf705edd22e622139a.png
5. Why are there so many trees on the map? 🌳
The game takes place on an Ancient Yucatan Peninsula, an area densely overgrown with humid equatorial forests. While creating your cities and braving the wilds you’ll get to feel like the Ancient Mayan and each house, farm field or temple will be a silent proof of the struggle your people put against those ancient forests.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39052778/a3ae78e7fe886609f7b55103ba60fc81af46bd43.png
That’s it for today. Hopefully now you know more about the background of the game and armed with this new knowledge you’ll enjoy the gameplay more! 👍 As always, we’d like to invite you to join our discord and add the game to your wishlists on Steam to not miss out on any further updates! 



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39052778/5d85522441c744d2eea4300ae6a297bb196c2da2.png
 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1451470/El_Dorado_The_Golden_City_Builder/ 

See you soon,
El Dorado Team

notes.title: Rain Season
notes.content:
Hello Builders! 👋

As we’ve already mentioned in the previous devlogs, the climate changes throughout your El Dorado gameplay will be one of the determining factors altering your gameplay. Our goal was to make you experience the power of the ancient Yucatan Peninsula’s nature. ⛈️ That’s especially true for the rain season. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39052778/df52973111f6171aa339d20f1c74bb6710744d42.png
This time of the year is not kind and you’ll experience it on different levels while taking care of your citizens or structures. 😥 Every year for a few months the entire world drowns in the neverending rain. The ground soaks wet, creating massive swampy puddles and the buildings leak and fall apart making your subjects homeless with no place to hide from the omnipresent humidity.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39052778/b7cc913a8a39cdbb1b5349d75e89e898c17ea4d1.gif
To become a worthy leader 👑 to the ancient city, you’ll have to face and overcome these environmental struggles. The solution is simple but requires some careful planning. Stone squares were one of them. These platforms not only add some magnificence to the looks of the buildings but also save the houses from flooding. This feature will undoubtedly make building your cities more interesting and unique. 🤩 You might also want to invest in some stone roads connecting your buildings together. This will help your people work and maneuver through the puddles of mud. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39052778/2d35a18860635a2fcbc49d2e4a884eff57cebd50.png
The severity of those climate conditions don’t end there. Most of the trading and fights will be suspended and many preparations for the dry season need to be completed. We’ve already told you about the Chultuns- the tanks carved in stone in which you’ll need to collect water and ensure your citizens don’t face drought. ☀️ 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39052778/bb4510469631d72d68ce73ddd6b47918af09bbfe.png
We’d love to hear what aspects of the game you would like to hear more about. Perhaps after all the devlogs you’d like us to give you more details about certain aspects of the game? 🤔 Let us know in the comments! If you enjoy our work thus far, we invite you to join our discord community and add the game to your wishlists on Steam! 👇

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1451470/El_Dorado_The_Golden_City_Builder/ 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39052778/5d85522441c744d2eea4300ae6a297bb196c2da2.png 

See you soon,
El Dorado Team

notes.title: Gods
notes.content:
Hello Players! 👋

Our priests predicted gods’ wrath falling upon our people in the imminent future. 😨 To prevent that from happening, you have to learn more about gods to serve them better!

Ancient Maya world was overflowing with mysticism and the humongous pantheon of gods played a pivotal role in people’s everyday life. 🙏 Those heavenly entities patronized different aspects of life. Through sacrifices and various rituals your people will be able to appease the gods 🙇 and ask for their favors in the atmosphere of mystery and horror. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39052778/554ad2cebb39cbc8472c65ea505023393dbb6a33.png
During your adventure in El Dorado, you’ll get to meet the most important and majestic representatives of the godly elites. Let’s visit the godly domain and meet some of its inhabitants! The most important one being none other than Hun Hunahpu- god of corn, the first father, overseer of creation. He was the one who created the pathways for the stars throughout the entire sky, shaping the fate of every person. 🤯 There is also the godly couple Chac Chel and Chac, goddess of weaving and god of thunder and heavy rains. ⚡

The next charismatic couple in the El Dorado world are the god of wisdom Itzamna with his goddess Ix Chel, the patroness of medicine and tokology. 👶 She was the most important goddess when it came to pray for a numerous offspring and healthy life. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39052778/5f838202c335da39bfe0bbfe10a9c6d30850655e.gif
During our small trip we couldn’t miss visiting the most prosperous entity, the god of trade Ek Chauj’a. It’s the right target for sacrifices if you strive for success in the business when a foreign caravan arrives in your city. 💰

Successful deal has to be celebrated and what’s a better way to do it if not accompanied by alcohol, good fun, dances, singing and of course, a small war. Those are all the aspects of the famous god Akan, but where there is war, death follows and with death comes the demonic god Cizin. 💀

Finally, there is the crème de la crème, the gigachad among chads, the sun god Kinich Ahau, supreme emperor hovering over the world. ☀️

Let’s not disturb the peace of this place any longer and end this short trip. Now you’re familiar with the gods and their aspects. Use this knowledge to your advantage and get ahead of your enemies with timely and most importantly, propper sacrifices and rituals to claim the gods’ favors. 👍

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39052778/119e36c7ce93ef5d79f63cbe4b7ed8f8ecdbabe9.png
If you’ve enjoyed the devlog, consider adding the game to your wishlists on Steam and join our discord community where you can meet other people interested in the game. 🙂

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39052778/5d85522441c744d2eea4300ae6a297bb196c2da2.png

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1451470/El_Dorado_The_Golden_City_Builder/

notes.title: Cuisine
notes.content:
Hello Builders! 👋

Last time, we’ve been talking about food production, 🌽 the core of each successful civilization. This time, we’d like to go one step further and take a closer look at Ancient Maya diet. 🔍

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39052778/3d32cca476be5836f80da4ce551179c2edc735bc.png
If you’ve imagined their diet as plain, boring and repeatable we’d like to clear this misunderstanding. It was a varied diet full of fruits 🍌, veggies 🥔 and different kinds of meat. 🍖 Their everyday meals were rich in different flavors and that particular quality was able to satisfy even the most picky eaters.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39052778/1967467a07125ad0a69af36c28586e2f007f9143.png
A well-fed man is a happy one. In order to keep your citizens happy 😀 and willing to work 💪 you’ll have to provide your community with enough food. During your gameplay in El Dorado many different buildings associated with food production will be available. Some of them specialize in the preparation of raw ingredients while others prepare the meals. 📝

One of such buildings is the bakery in which the Waaj bread is prepared. This building also has another, even more important task. It prepares the corn flour, an ingredient used for many purposes such as preparing thick, rich sauces or stuffed pies called Tamales. 🧑‍🍳

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39052778/f0c8915be9216b6155c9da069f323257418b201c.png
The culinary heart of the city is undoubtedly the kitchen in which many dishes are prepared and seasoned with hot spices. 🌶️ The food is cooked in various ways: grilled, stewed or fried on stones.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39052778/598769963694aab08addb21c9d8e8d8bbf717757.gif
Can there be a good meal without an equally tasty beverage? 🤔 

One of the most basic but still delicious drinks your society enjoys is Ah- TOH- lay, a sweet corn drink. During your playthrough you’ll have an opportunity to prepare even more exclusive drinks such as Kakawal- a hot chocolate 🍫 or Balche, an alcoholic drink. 

We hope you enjoyed this devlog and will eagerly explore the world of ancient Yucatan Peninsula cuisine with El Dorado: the Golden City Builder. If you have any suggestion, advice or question don’t hesitate to visit our discord 👇 and let us know! If you like our work and would like to support us, please add our game to your wishlists! 👍

See you soon,
El Dorado Team

notes.title: Food
notes.content:
Hello Players! 👋

As all of you are well aware of, El Dorado is not just about rituals, building and army. Its huge part is the daily life of the inhabitants, observing them and making the society grow. 👍 

In this devlog, we’d like to slow things down and take a closer look at what lays at the very base of each successful civilization- the food. 🌽 In our game, players will have an option to build various objects focusing on food production. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39052778/1ec4aa4c29a13fc946b246232001fb88306db106.png
Before any kind of plants can be sown, the ground needs to be prepared. Once this step is taken care of, you can start cultivating your first veggies! 🤩 One of the key parts of your citizens everyday diet is corn. One of the multiple purposes you can use it for is to make corn flour and turn it into a beautiful, tasty cornbread. 🍞 To diversify your diet you may consider planting some beans or tomatoes which can later become a mouth-watering stew. 🤤

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39052778/e738fbe666a17772141acc534138bc4e4ce08811.png
On top of that, you’ll be able to start planting cacao trees and chili peppers 🌶️ two main components to prepare their ceremonial bitter spicy hot chocolate which was said to give strength to the brave warriors and wisdom to the emperors.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39052778/5391046751b7a0c072c882285964a343006a6f37.png
Speaking of mystical potions, you may consider building some beehives for wild bees 🐝. Their delicious honey is one of the ingredients the shaman mentioned for a medicine. Maybe you should pay him a visit and find out more details? 🤔

Every now and then your people would love to have some juicy meat to go with their meals. A poultry farm is most definitely a good thing to have. Turkeys, ducks… they’ll undoubtedly become a great source of proteins! 🦃

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39052778/e738fbe666a17772141acc534138bc4e4ce08811.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39052778/6ff322f9d856348c60546948aca3adf26c166a84.gif
With this quick introduction taking care of the food requirements will not be a challenge! Let us know in the comments if you’d like us to add any specific feature! 🙂 We can’t wait to hear your ideas. If you’ve enjoyed the contents of this devlog please consider adding our game to your wishlists and join our discord where you can meet the developers and have a real impact on how the final game looks like! 👍

notes.title: Warpath
notes.content:
Hello Players! 👋

It’s good to see you again in yet another devlog from El Dorado: The Golden City Builder! 🙂 This month, we’d like to give you an insight into a mechanic mentioned in the previous devlogs. 🤩 That’s right! This time, we’ll talk about WARS! ⚔️ Build your garrisons and let’s take a look at this aspect of our game. 🔍

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39052778/2288471e8e2d18c89cde08dac3e99cf11e6e5e12.gif
In the world of El Dorado players will get to feel like a real ruler! 👑 During your gameplay you’ll have an opportunity to create alliances with other Mayan tribes or exactly the opposite- declare war on them! 💀

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39052778/a1bc94c3c87dcc37de87c0b84a69bb9cab912d45.png
Keep in mind that careless war declaration may spell doom to your people. Therefore, before declaring your not so friendly intentions you should get yourself a capable weaponsmith workshop like the one shown above. ☝️ With such skilled craftsmen, your armies will be prepared for even the most demanding skirmishes! 💪

Declaring war to another lineage will give players access to the attack order. Defeating the enemy troops will make the other Monarchs of great Mayan Cities treat you with more respect. You’ll also acquire the spoils of war. 💎 Use them to make your nation prosper! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39052778/210b3c0f4ff3a986f75ce0dc2cd3b1316d814ef8.png
The building you’ve just seen is quite important. The gentlemen wandering around the facility are Slave Hunters. 🏹 One of the most important military operations is carried by them! Send your Hunters into the dense, wild forests to find camps and acquire slaves. ⛓️ From our previous materials you already know the variety of uses for slaves. ❤️‍🔥

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39052778/b520090c2a835a19e27a71eb7779906c80727c66.gif

There is only one issue, while you can indeed attack the other tribes… you can also become the target of an attack. That’s why you should consider building some defensive structures.🛡️ One of such buildings is watchtower. With the help of this building your subjects will be able to notice the incoming danger 👀 much quicker! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39052778/05bd736f18486bb8a46347171ff0725ab99cc0e0.png
Those are only some of the possibilities waiting for you to explore! Do you like this aspect so far? Let us know your opinions in the comment section! Don’t forget to join our Ddiscord community 👇 and share your ideas for the contents of the game with our developers! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39052778/5d85522441c744d2eea4300ae6a297bb196c2da2.png

notes.title: Slaves
notes.content:
Builders! 👋

It’s time for our monthly devlog and as promised, this time we’ll introduce you to a social group which is very numerous and important for the prosperity of your city- Slaves! ⛓️

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39052778/5ea7ba19669687f6dfbad88d522b6463b328d64e.png
In the ancient Mayan empire the wheel wasn’t used for the creation of some sort of transportation device. Therefore, most of the goods were being moved by people 🚶often equipped with baskets. And that’s where slaves step in- a numerous work force to relieve the citizens from the physical labor. 💪 Use them wisely to propel your economy! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39052778/07a45a3f822fbdbf0b2805cd76c7175795014d21.png
Their function in society wasn’t just physical work. As we’ve previously mentioned, the Mayan Gods ⚡ were demanding, capricious and vengeful 😡 beings who didn’t bat an eye while punishing their followers as soon as they felt like they weren't given as many prayers and sacrifices as they deserved.

That’s why ancient Mayan were often having festivals full of music, incense, fire and of course- blood. But where to take that blood from? 🤔 Why would they slay their own valued citizens when slaves just waited to take their place on the altar? 

Offering them in their mystical, bloody rituals will please even the most demanding God. 👍 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39052778/f1a3c47e5803eb860bf42f2f597139ca8ebfb0d3.gif

And you, as the rightful ruler, should learn from their traditions and follow their steps to ensure the wellbeing of your city and its inhabitants. 

The life of a few sounds like a fair price in exchange for the protection from famine, plagues, elemental cataclysms, as well as a good fortune during wars, gathering crops and hunting! 😀

Keep in mind that even slaves have their needs that have to be taken care of. In order to use them up to the very last drop of their blood you have to create a proper environment for the unwilling inhabitants of your city, you should at least grant them a roof over their head 🏠 and something to eat and drink. 🌽 🥛

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39052778/851395e8130912e772db58c3d8373f873c2f37fd.png
Unfortunately that brings us to an end of this devlog but before you go we’d like to remind you that El Dorado: The Golden City Builder DEMO version takes part in the upcoming Seam Next Fest starting June 19, 2023, at 7 PM CEST! 🤩🎉 Don’t forget to add our game to your wishlist 👇 and join our discord 👇 where you can easily let us know what other features would you like to see in the final version of the game!

notes.title: Seasons
notes.content:
Hello Builders! 👋

It’s been a while since you’ve heard of us but we’re back with another devlog and this time, we’ll talk about the weather! ⛈️

In our game, we’d like to give you an experience of what the life of the Mayans of that time looked like. Therefore, we cannot skip one of the most crucial factors- the weather. 🤩

Life of the Ancient Mayans society was dictated by two seasons: rainy season 🌧️ and dry season. ☀️ They both had their pros and cons and people were always doing their best to exploit those advantages. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39052778/58ebb02c5e4727d262d558e073d5368744b0c0d8.png

Let’s start with the dry season. 🌞

During that time of the year, the fertile soil- one of the main sources of food for your people is deprived of the life giving rain. 💧 To protect your city from the draught you’ll be forced to look for alternative sources of water. One of such sources were cenote- natural wells. They were natural rock formations in which the water was getting collected. During the golden era of Mayan Empire, cenotes were not only used as a well but also believed to be gates to the realm of Gods! 🙏

It was also the time when the ground was solid. Therefore, it was the time of wars, trading and politics between different cities. ⚔️

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39052778/363a662e305977092806f69b020461dac8a80be4.png

As for the rainy season… 🤔 It was a time when most of the conflicts, trades and escapades were halted. 

And the reason for that? The overwhelming, omnipresent and never ending rain covering every square cm of the land veiling the earth in the shadows. ⛈️ 

The overflowing water was turning ground into mud pools making moving dangerous and nigh impossible. To make sure your progress won’t be stopped we suggest investing in stone roads. 🛣️

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39052778/aa8b617fdf87e297b85fade25b179b40dba448db.gif

This season is also the perfect time to collect water necessary to survive the dry season. With the use of tanks carved in the stone by people called chultuns you’ll have a possibility to do so! 👍

Those inconspicuously looking structures built on the circular plan allow to collect incredible amounts of water inside them. They are your best shot to make sure your people won’t suffer from thirst!

That brings us to the end of this devlog. We’d like to remind you about the Playtests currently taking place! 📝 To take part in them, all you have to do is visit the main page of the game, find the Playtest banner and press the green button “Request Access”! It’s that simple! 🤩 We invite you to try the game out and give us your feedback. Don’t forget to add the game to your wishlists 👇 and join our discord community! 👇

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39052778/5d85522441c744d2eea4300ae6a297bb196c2da2.png 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1451470/El_Dorado_The_Golden_City_Builder/ 


See you soon,

notes.title: Religion
notes.content:
Hello Builders! 👋

The last time you’ve heard from us we’ve mentioned the topic of today’s devlog - the Gods. 

We’ve warned you not to underestimate them, provoke them or ignore your religious duties. Today you’ll hear more about the Religion mechanic in our game! 🤩

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39052778/4608f8dfa0fac41b215abb59533cd222f17514bb.png

In the old times, Gods ⚡ weren’t just the creators and destroyers of life, they were also its maintainers. People believed that zealous faith and showing the Gods their utmost respect will bring them good fortune 🍀, protection 🛡️, victory on the battlefield and all the good things one could wish for.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39052778/65443a15764c13b799668d8e84f32bc36a9c03a4.png

Therefore, you’ll have to follow their example. Build temples and shrines 🛐 near the houses where every now and then you’ll have to offer sacrifices to appease the Gods, win their favors and what’s most important - secure the village from all the dangers ☠️ lurking around every corner.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39052778/7b3c7ea7d3aa8b426ae863778e97686a0aabef9d.png

You can offer the sacrifices during the festivals in the temple. At that time, head priests  perform mystical, 🩸 bloody rituals for the glory of the God-Kings of the world. The more sacrifices are offered, the more favorably the Gods will look upon your people.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39052778/f1a3c47e5803eb860bf42f2f597139ca8ebfb0d3.gif

In your civilization, three Gods tower over all the others:
🌩️ Chac, the God of thunder, water and plants. Keeper of the four directions of the world 
🌑 Ixchel, the Goddess of the moon, fertility and destruction 
🌌 Itzamna, the God creator, ruler of the skies 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39052778/980d26399d4f47281a7ecfcfef14e643df136c3f.png

At this point you may have asked yourselves… How will you be able to predict which God needed to be given a sacrifice to protect your civilization from a calamity? 🤔

That’s simple! The most talented fortune-tellers worked together and created the calendar 📅 to help you with your religious duties and predict which God needs to be prayed to.

Ancient civilizations also thrived in astronomy. ✨ Their priests could’ve predicted the future using stars! Be it a deposit of a rare, valuable ore, calamity 🌋 or an enemy tribe preparing to attack ⚔️  them, stars held the knowledge about all of that. Will you regain this skill and use it to your advantage while bringing your civilization to prosperity?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39052778/0fa1bce3ff1e526e16ed76f9ecb07e0912550f76.png

Let us know your thoughts about those mechanics! We can’t wait to hear your ideas and opinions. 💭 Maybe you’ve got some wishes about the contents of the game? Join our discord community 👇 and talk about them with the game devs directly! Also, add the game to your wishlist 👇 to never miss on any further update!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39052778/3c416b9afa528365e434b128617ef297d5f55741.png

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1451470/El_Dorado_The_Golden_City_Builder/ 


See you soon,
El Dorado Team

notes.title: Building system
notes.content:
Hello Builders! 👋

     Our development is progressing smoothly and this time, we are excited to introduce you to the building system in our game! ⚒️

     In this devlog we’ll give you a little insight into one of the most crucial mechanics in the game - building. Choose your structures wisely and create an entirely unique City! 🌇Take care of buildings in many different branches in order to bring your civilization to the heights yet to be seen! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39052778/ba94d5a8450f73771e14f6bcb72c85c0c137e430.gif

     Are the materials what you need make your city thrive, or perhaps new citizens and skilled craftsmen? You can always build a temple for the glory of the gods 🏛️ and hopefuly, your prayers will be listened.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39052778/0dce6b36b5ff9bc553cde6ce035a45b4f25cd65d.png

     We all know the El Dorado isn’t a fair place. That’s why we provide you with 3️⃣ different building to house your citizens based on their status 🧍💎

1️⃣ Slaves barracks, for your unwilling citizens
2️⃣ Commoners house, home to the backbone of the community
3️⃣ Elites house, place where spiritualized citizens specialized in the divine realm reside

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39052778/bf1985ff8b8e0f74a5fdc97f3ce7472a4e3a158a.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39052778/f24211c100317bd7ef8a8123d915061641b3dd62.png

    Don’t forget to gather the resources you need to build the best city in the world and make it happen, make sure you use the unique gathering and production buildings to their fullest! 🪓 ⛏️ 🍴

     Be it a farm, woodcutter, gatherer’s hut, miners, hunter’s hut or chultune - they’ll all sustain the income of your resources and allow your weavers, tailors, brewers and cooks to change them into quality of life resources your citizens crave.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39052778/fc539e68fdf4fedaa19764e5c7eebfa6c06a81d7.png


     But no matter whose temple it is, or what resource the building provides you with, always make sure to have a great quality road to lead your fellow citizens to their destination.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39052778/c9e1c08a303b879d32c7b92fab7946f0f4b28e0a.gif

     The building system in our game is the most crucial aspect for your development. Plan the layout, manage and prioritize both material and human resources to lead your golden city of El Dorado to glory. Make your choice whether risking the wraith of gods is worth sparing life of some people.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39052778/b1d968f0193f7a436556a719414f5ba5cbc3e4af.gif

     We are also happy to announce the next devlog being all about the slave management system. 🤸👬 🏋️To make sure you don’t miss on it, add our game to your wishlist and click the link below to join our discord community alongside other builders out there. Stay tuned! 🤩👇 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39052778/3c416b9afa528365e434b128617ef297d5f55741.png

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1451470/El_Dorado_The_Golden_City_Builder/


See You soon,
El Dorado Team

notes.title: Welcome in new El Dorado! 🗿
notes.content:
Welcome Golden City Enjoyers!🗿

The game has new developers and this will be the first of monthly posted devlogs about the development of the game!🥳

A new beginning for game development and we are really excited about that. We changed the whole Steam Page of El Dorado - description, graphics, screens, and trailer. For us the most important in the past few weeks, was to show you what the game looks like right now, that's why we decided to record a new gameplay trailer, and you can watch it now! ⤵️
[previewyoutube=hGj0lVaCIg0;full][/previewyoutube]

The game is in the early stages of production so we will be sharing all kinds of curiosities, achievements and notable moments.😃

So… are you ready for El Dorado?😏

Where are we going?🌐
To the Yucatán Peninsula!😮
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39052778/c68dca810da502d56752b8d9d64979a85bbe7260.jpg
Which is rich in animals 🐆 but poor in drinkable water 💧😫

When are we going?⌚
The game will take place in  Pre-Columbian era🗿 in the blossoming times of the Mayan culture being around the classical period of 250-900 CE. 🤓
And If you like city states, get ready for a lot of them, because you will be the founder  of one 😎

At the Will of Gods🥺
The game is a journey to ancient times, when the very existence of a man was dictated by Gods.
The world of ancient Yucatán is often visited by natural disasters being the manifestation of Gods’ wrath including droughts, fires and plagues🕷🦗
Bloody🩸sacrifices will be needed to get on Gods’ good side, the end goal being of course to build… THE GOLDEN CITY🥇

In order to do that you will not only be a founder of your city state, but also THE HIGHEST PRIEST 😈

Hope you’re as excited as we are to build the Greatest Golden City the World has ever seen!🤑
Talk about it with us in our Discord
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39052778/3c416b9afa528365e434b128617ef297d5f55741.png

And wishlist the game to get all the freshest news delivered directly to YOU!
